issues.description: Milkable.messageOnMilk is specified in the problem statement/UML as a no-argument method `messageOnMilk(): String` returning "[Animal Type] [name] is milked", and Main (commented example) calls `m.messageOnMilk()` with no arguments. However, the solution defines `Milkable.messageOnMilk(double volume)` and implements it in Seal/Goat with an extra parameter and different output including the volume, making the solution incompatible with the stated interface contract and example usage.
issues.suggestedFix: Make all artifacts consistent by changing the solution interface to `String messageOnMilk()` (no parameters) and updating Seal/Goat to return exactly `"<Type> " + getName() + " is milked"`; keep Main calling `m.messageOnMilk()` without arguments. Alternatively, if volume is intended, update the problem statement/UML and any examples/templates to require `messageOnMilk(double volume)` and define the required output format accordingly.
